result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on functional equations for auxiliary functions φ, χ, ψ, ζ under a linear substitution ay+bz=c, solved by series, together with fragmentary notes on partial differential equations and an energy-type integral.

methods.what: Coupled functional equations for ψ and ζ
Series solution of the functional equation for ψ
Quadratic whose roots α, α1 (product 1) give the fixed points of the Möbius iteration
Normal form of the linear fractional map via its multiplier λ
Velocity-dependent (Weber-type) interaction term and energy conservation
